lead: DOM VIRUS is a family of tiny open-source arcade games that play on a real webpage. The DOM is the game board: letters become points and buttons become enemy factories. Hit Recall to give the page back. By Chris Cooley · coded.design.

items.label: games playable today: four on the page, two board games

body.text: Each embedded game plays across the page you are reading, then gives it back on Recall. No install to play.
DOM Battlefield and Battlefield Blitz are full board games built from Sherman Bytes, played on their own site.
Battlefield Blitz runs on Fizlet, the family's small engine. The embedded games move onto it next.

items.title: 01 Sherman Bytes
items.body: DOM TANK. Deploy a pixel tank onto a live webpage, breach button bases and hold the page. 27.0 kB gzip.

items.title: 02 DOM Battlefield
items.body: SQUAD TACTICS. Command a squad of up to twelve Sherman tanks on a cyberpunk grid built from real page elements.

items.title: 03 Battlefield Blitz
items.body: DOM BLITZ. Same tanks, every crew for itself. Parachute in, call airstrikes, most kills wins.

items.title: 04 Swarm Protocol
items.body: DOM DEFENSE. Release a swarm onto the page, then defend it before the bugs eat it into binary. 34.6 kB gzip.

items.title: 05 Byte Runner
items.body: DOM CHASE. A hungry pixel frog races through the page's whitespace, eats real text and hunts escaping flies. 29.2 kB gzip.

items.title: 06 Null Invaders
items.body: DOM SHOOTER. Fly an interceptor through a real webpage and break the button factories. 22.9 kB gzip.

items.title: Logos and icons
items.body: SVG and PNG icons for DOM VIRUS, DOM Battlefield and DOM Kaiju, plus the share image, in the hub repository.

items.title: Screenshots
items.body: Play any game and capture it as it runs on the page. Ask through the contact page for anything else.
